physical_column_model.coordinate: z positive downward from local surface; q positive as downward temperature gradient/upward conductive surface flux in OrbData convention.
physical_column_model.steady_layer_equation: d/dz(k dT/dz)+A=0; for constant k,A: T(z)=T_top+q_top*z/k-A*z^2/(2k), and q(z)=k*dT/dz=q_top-A*z.
physical_column_model.density_equation: rho(T)=rho_ref*(1-alpha*(T-T_ref))+delta_rho_chemical; keep thermal and chemical terms separate.
physical_column_model.geometry_policy: Crust thickness comes from authored physical crust field/domain. Continental total lithosphere reference thickness is authored by thermal domain. Ocean HWR equilibrium plate thickness is not automatically ShellSet mechanical lithosphere thickness. Ridge uses a separate finite boundary rule.

MATERIAL_OR_DOMAIN_PARAMETER: crust k,rho,alpha,heat production,solidus; mantle production/solidus; asthenosphere reference density/profile
AUTHORED_T0_FIELD: continental q and reference thickness; physical crust thickness/domain; ocean age; selected ridge support
DERIVED_STATE: positive-age HWR flux; kappa=k/(rho Cp); TADIAB/TAsthK after adiabat rule; joined heat-flow field
SPECIALIST_MODEL_CONFIGURATION: HWR solver controls; solidus/temLim; ocean thickness mapping; curvature and fail-closed policies

TSurf.authority: A0.6D HWR-2; bind OrbData tSurf only for same reference surface

governed_heat_flux.rule: Prescribed producer flux remains the surface boundary; solve inward and fail closed if infeasible; never invert profile to replace flux.

surface_boundary.surface_energy_condition: q_s=-k grad(T) dot n_out; positive q_s produces increasing T with depth.

crust_contract.geometry: Authored cellwise physical crust thickness; normal ocean 6.5 km and continental domain 25-50 km. Do not infer composition from thermal class.
crust_contract.material: k_C, rhoBar_C, alpha_C, A_C and crust reference temperature/solidus are unselected ARCANA material/domain parameters.
crust_contract.radiogenic_model: Minimum PRE_ORBDATA structure is one uniform bulk-crust A_C per authorized crust material/domain (option A); no upper/lower layers or regional geochemistry are supported by current T0.

moho_contract.conductive_flux: q_M(0)=q_C(h_C)=q_s-A_C*h_C absent explicit interface source/sink; none is authorized.
moho_contract.conductivity_transition: k_C and k_M may differ; gradient changes as q/k, but flux remains continuous.
moho_contract.source_requirement: Use one Moho temperature to seed both layers. In the audited curvature convention the crust-side correction uses k_C; legacy multiplication by k_M creates a flux jump when k differs.

mantle_lithosphere_contract.geometry: Ocean HWR zp=100 km (80-140) is total thermal plate depth only under its HWR meaning; mantle thickness is zp-h_C only if its basal boundary is explicitly adopted as OrbData LAB. Continental total thickness is authored 200/135/80 km; mantle residual is total minus actual cell crust thickness and must be positive.

shared_material_values.source: A0.6D; bind same effective mantle authority to HWR and OrbData mantle consumer.

mantle_lithosphere_contract.heat_production: A_M is unselected; zero is not an implicit default. T_M(x)=T_Moho+q_Moho*x/k_M-A_M*x^2/(2*k_M), absent separately authorized curvature.
mantle_lithosphere_contract.basal_reference: HWR Tb=1680 K (1523-1737) and zp do not alone define OrbData potential-temperature intercept or mechanical mantle thickness.

lab_asthenosphere_contract.definition: LAB is mantle-lithosphere base where geotherm joins governed asthenosphere adiabat; it is not ZBASTH or HWR zp by implication.
lab_asthenosphere_contract.criterion: No ARCANA solidus, rheological, or supplied LAB-temperature criterion selected.
lab_asthenosphere_contract.adiabat: dT_ad/dz=alpha*g*T/Cp; at A0.6D point values and g=9.82, local slope is about 0.412 K/km. This derived slope is not an authorized TADIAB intercept or constant-gradient convention.
lab_asthenosphere_contract.TAsthK: Audited source sets TAsthK=TADIAB+GRADIE*100000 m. Bind only after TADIAB, reference depth and GRADIE convention are co-governed and match modeled LAB temperature.
lab_asthenosphere_contract.temLim: Squeez density-integration cap, not a selected material solidus; it does not directly cap emitted profile.
lab_asthenosphere_contract.ZBASTH: Separate mantle structure/mechanical depth; source Earth example is not ARCANA authority.

ocean_column_contract.positive_age_flux: For t>0: H(t)=k(Tb-T0)/zp*[1+2 sum exp(-kappa*i^2*pi^2*t/zp^2)], kappa=k/(rho_M*Cp). Use A0.6D parameters and authorized age support.
ocean_column_contract.HWR_plate_meaning: Depth of HWR finite-plate basal isothermal boundary from its surface; thermal model thickness, not intrinsically mechanical or mantle-only thickness.
ocean_column_contract.mapping: Conditional only: if basal boundary is authorized as OrbData LAB, h_total=zp and h_M=zp-h_C. Not currently ratified.
ocean_column_contract.nonphysical_result: If zp<=h_C or h_M<=0, reject column; never clamp or silently change q/zp.
ocean_column_contract.ridge: Use q=0.3 W m-2 and authored zero-age state; never evaluate HWR at t=0. Ridge thickness/basal mapping unresolved.

continental_column_contract.surface_authority: Retain authored T0 q; do not derive replacement flux.
continental_column_contract.crust: Use actual authored cellwise physical thickness; candidate mantle residual=H_total-h_C and must be positive.
continental_column_contract.existence: A finite piecewise solution exists algebraically for finite q,A and positive k; physical admissibility and LAB matching cannot be determined without material and basal authority.

ridge_column_contract.support: Selected 108 age-zero cells only; other divergent candidates remain non-ridge/unknown.
ridge_column_contract.column: Use authored crust; require positive mantle residual and LAB match. No ridge-specific basal/thickness rule is selected.

radiogenic_heat_contract.choice: One uniform bulk-crust production value per authorized material/domain is the minimum model structure. No regional geochemical resolution exists; A_C remains unselected.
radiogenic_heat_contract.mantle: A_M independently governed; zero must be explicit, not default.
radiogenic_heat_contract.literature: Sammon et al. 2022 (10.1029/2022JB024041) infer deep continental composition/production from Earth geochemical/geophysical inputs and calculate Moho flux by subtracting integrated production from surface flux. Supports balance equation, not transfer of Earth's crust inventory to ARCANA.
radiogenic_heat_contract.uncertainty: No ARCANA numeric interval authored. Do not fabricate one; sensitivity must sweep future authorized bounds.

curvature_correction_contract.rule: No Moho source/sink is authorized; require temperature and conductive flux continuity.
curvature_correction_contract.source_behavior: For audited cooling_curvature=c, corrected q_Moho=q_s-A_C*h_C-c*h_C*k_C; legacy expression uses k_M and is inconsistent for k_C!=k_M. Seed mantle from exact crust Moho temperature.
curvature_correction_contract.transient: Solve curvature jointly with basal/LAB and both layer balances. If unavailable, set curvature zero for reference solution and fail closed if adiabat join fails.

isostatic_density_contract.rhoBar_C: Unselected; same authority as crust material.
isostatic_density_contract.rhoAst: Unselected independent reference-column density/profile; do not copy rhoBar_M by default.
isostatic_density_contract.thermal_effect: rho_thermal=rho_ref*[1-alpha*(T-T_ref)] after rho, alpha and T_ref are authorized.
isostatic_density_contract.chemical_anomaly: Keep delta_rho separate; do not infer chemistry from isostatic stress to hide thermal mismatch.
isostatic_density_contract.delta_rho_limit: Source +/-100 kg m-3 is unqualified numerical guard, not ARCANA authority. No silent clipping; require authored chemical bounds and fail closed.

profile_consistency_checks.method: Static equations and existing bounds only; unselected properties are never imputed.

monotonicity.check: Requires q_s-A_C*h_C>=0 in crust and q_Moho-A_M*h_M>=0 in mantle, with curvature jointly solved; missing bounds prevent proof.

moho_flux.check: q_Moho=q_s-A_C*h_C; curvature uses k_C on crust side.

lab_temperature.reason: No LAB mapping or adiabat intercept.

thickness.check: Continental total classes 80-200 km exceed broad crust domain 25-50 km; possible residual range 30-175 km if extrema co-occur. Conditional ocean zp-h_C=73.5-133.5 km for 80-140 km zp and 6.5 km normal crust only if zp is LAB depth. Ridge unresolved.

domain_extrema.check: Continental q 0.045-0.085; ridge 0.3; ocean nominal 0.0476525-0.4741483 and sensitivity 0.0322191-0.5815391 W m-2. Temperature extrema unavailable without full material vector.

profile_consistency_checks.decision: Cannot pass nominal and sensitivity profile checks without unsupported material values.

not_closed: HWR-to-LAB/OrbData thickness mapping and ridge basal condition
TADIAB/GRADIE consistent with HWR boundary over sensitivity
config_v1_readiness.policy: No partial heat-flow Config V1; it would imply unqualified geotherm/isostatic state.

required_source_changes: Preserve explicit ARCANA heatFl through age and guards; GDH1/qLim1 overwrite legacy-only.
Remove independent GDH1/95-km ARCANA thickness path; consume one governed mapping.
Use shared Moho temperature and conservative flux; curvature factor k_C or equivalent.
Fail closed on profile/adiabat/solidus failure; no silent heat-flow/thickness mutation.
Keep UNKNOWN distinct from numeric zero and preserve provenance.

remaining_scientific_blockers.statement: No single governed ARCANA reference-column material package binds bulk crust material/geochemistry and radiogenic production, mantle production/solidus, asthenosphere reference, and meaning of HWR finite-plate boundary relative to OrbData LAB/adiabat. Numeric profile and isostatic checks would require inventing physical values.
remaining_scientific_blockers.why_smallest: These coupled quantities jointly define the same column energy balance, layer geometry and density reference; treat as one missing authority rather than separate blockers.

remaining_implementation_blockers: Correct source heat-flow overwrite/guard behavior and remove stock GDH1 thickness path for ARCANA.
Implement conservative Moho curvature after authority approval.
Qualify source-generalization patch and adapter through fair qualification/regression path.
Provide canonical FEG support with explicit UNKNOWN mask and complete nonzero coverage.
